name: benchmark-mixedQA-IFT
description: benchmark-mixedQA-IFT measures a model's ability to answer a heterogeneous set of question types drawn from multiple domains, combining multiple-choice, short-answer, and open-ended QA items. It evaluates both factual recall and reasoning under an in‑fine‑tuned (IFT) setup, focusing on robustness across formats and topics. The dataset is intended to assess general-purpose language models' adaptability to mixed QA formats.
reputation: A small community / experimental benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for mixed-format QA testing.
